purpose: Matched-query asymmetric component commitment on the frozen ACT development tasks.

policy.implementation: official LeRobot ACT predict_action_chunk with native policy and environment postprocessors

tasks.task_name: pick up the butter and place it in the basket
pick up the black bowl from table center and place it on the plate
put the bowl on the stove
put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

global_8_8.semantics: At every policy query both components switch to the newest queried source chunk. Execute chunk_q[t-q].

arm8_grip16.semantics: Arm switches at every query. Gripper switches only at physical steps divisible by 16 and otherwise executes the same-target prediction from its committed source chunk.

arm16_grip8.semantics: Gripper switches at every query. Arm switches only at physical steps divisible by 16 and otherwise executes the same-target prediction from its committed source chunk.

analysis.paired_unit: same task, initial-state ID, environment seed, checkpoint, and policy RNG seed
analysis.positive_rule: arm8_grip16 candidate-only minus reference-only >= 3, directionally better than arm16_grip8, with no clear catastrophic regression on one task
